title: Version 1.5.9 - Gemini 2.5 Pro Support
description: Windsurf Editor released version 1.5.9 with Gemini 2.5 Pro (Beta) support and fixes for Remote-SSH extension. Recent releases also include new Windsurf Tab experience, context improvements, Cascade auto-linter, and MCP server integration.

title: Version 0.86.0 - GPT-5 and Grok-4 Support
description: Aider v0.86.0 added support for all GPT-5 models and Grok-4 via xAI and OpenRouter. Recent versions (0.83.0-0.86.0) added support for Gemini 2.5 Pro, DeepSeek V3, new /context command, co-authored-by attribution, and 130 new languages with linter support.

title: Version 1.3.38 - Config and Performance Improvements
description: Continue released v1.3.38-vscode with config.yaml fixes, session history filtering by workspace directory, and .continue/configs support. Recent updates include ClawRouter provider for cost-optimized routing, JetBrains remote config sync improvements, and Gemini 3 tool support.
